title: Three suitable mop stations
scope: Confirm locations, sanitation needs, equipment, installation, labeling, supply pars, and routine inspections.

title: Sanitary ice retrieval, storage, and production
scope: Establish dedicated ice tools, protected storage, cleaning/sanitizing practice, training, and inspection.

title: Lower beverage stations
scope: Plan beverage service and table-breakdown handling with proper separation, ergonomics, traffic flow, and cleaning ownership.

title: Daily and specials menu forecasting
scope: Standardize forecast inputs (reservations/events, history, weather where useful), prep pars, production communication, and variance checks.

title: Daily side-work and deep-cleaning lists
scope: Confirm culinary and stewarding checklists, assignments, sign-offs, shift verification, and exception follow-up.

title: Equipment deep-clean calendar
scope: Cover equipment and walk-in coolers; identify frequency, safe shutdown needs, trained owner, completion evidence, and oversight.

title: Winter preparedness
scope: Prepare for snow/ice and severe weather, receiving access, grounds treatment, staffing disruptions, supplies, and escalation.

title: Clean and organize shed
scope: Empty, sort, dispose/rehome, inventory and label; identify equipment needing repair, replacement, or evaluation.

title: Standardize cleaning contracts and kitchen maintenance ordering
scope: Consolidate vendor contacts, recurring services, order profiles, reorder standards, responsibilities, and documentation.
